title: nf-core/chipseq pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

replicate.errorMessage: Replicate id must be a positive integer!

antibody.errorMessage: Antibody entry must contain only alphanumeric characters, dots, and hyphens

control.errorMessage: Control entry must contain only alphanumeric characters, dots, and hyphens

control_replicate.errorMessage: Control replicate id must be a positive integer!
